reviews.text: We went to the daycare on a recommendation, but we were not disappointed. Berni and Peti are great teachers. They are very kind, it's obvious that they love dogs, and they provide us with lots of useful advice. There are lots of programs and a variety of activities (even dog sizes) to choose from. My dog ​​loves the daycare, but also the education. Everything here is about dogs, it's a real dog paradise.

We can only recommend them to everyone! They are very helpful, kind, and it is obvious that they know what they are doing. The training is great, they explain everything clearly and patiently, so the owners can learn a lot too. The dog daycare is a particularly big plus, and it is completely FREE! Bodza and I really like going here, and we can only recommend it to everyone who wants to raise a well-socialized, balanced dog. Thank you for all your help and work! ❤️

We started the dog daycare program with my 4-month-old German Vizsla puppy, and we will join the next basic training as well. The dog daycare provides a great opportunity for socialization and learning, the instructors are helpful, they help with everything, and the classes are held in a great atmosphere. This is a great help in our development. :)

Our experience at the doggy daycare was great. Kind, attentive instructors who provide a lot of information, which is especially useful as a first-time dog owner. The daycare was a great help in socializing our fearful puppy. We wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone!

Today we started at the daycare. We have been to other places, but I have never experienced such kindness in the way they spoke to and behaved with the puppies…🥰 It is worth noting that we learned a lot the first time too.
I felt a bit like I had gone to daycare and not the dog; I had a good time, I learned, I had fun, I got tired and slept afterwards…😅 Tódika Peeersze also had a great time!!😃 Thanks for the experience!!

We were at the free dog daycare in Csömör for the first time. We studied in the first half of the class, and in the second half the puppies played with each other under supervision. Berni and Peti are really great instructors, they show and explain everything in detail, and help with the correct execution of the tasks. We liked the first time so much that we will definitely continue to study with them.🥰🐶
Pacsi, Tony
Everyone is very helpful, patient and kind! They don't shy away from even the most problematic dogs 😊 …
Fantastically good school! With Berni and Peti's professional guidance, the dogs learn freely and become smarter.

Geniuses! I can only recommend them to all dog owners. They are kind, very professionally prepared, they don't disdain humor and good humor and they are honest, sometimes painfully so, but we learn from that too.

We looked at many schools before we decided to come here. We have a Husky, this breed is not liked in many places because of its stubbornness, but here Peti the Instructor welcomed us first to the kindergarten and then to the school with such love that he is second to none. It is a great place, the school and the instructor are characterized by expertise, love, and care, /kat/. The daycare is just gorgeous :) Since then, we have had 3 Huskies, of course, all of them are getting smarter under Peti's care, 2 of the dogs have already passed their exams, the third one is now going to Peti's kindergarten, their expertise is even more advanced, and their love for dogs is just as high!
Today we went to the kennel for the first time with our 3-month-old bullmastiff puppy Alice. We really liked the training, we met nice people. We recommend it for socializing dogs.
Super!!!!
They are consistent, helpful, and kind -> both the dog and its owner enjoy coming here.
They love what they do and they do it well.

I highly recommend this excellent dog school to anyone who believes in positive reinforcement. You can tell from the owners that they do it out of love. You can contact them with any question, they will try to help you to the best of their ability. They are also excellent in terms of price/value ratio.

We go to a dog park, the team is fantastic, we learn a lot!
I recommend it!
We love it ❤️🐶🐾 …
This was our first time at a dog daycare. We learned a lot on this occasion. We will definitely go again.

Professional and kind trainers. ☝️

The puppies learned in a safe area and then played freely.

Thank you for the opportunity!
I can only recommend it to everyone.
My dog, who used to have to be led into the car, jumps in without asking since we've been going to Peti's. Both the Ramaruzi and the school 5*.
Great place, they are helpful with everything. :)
For now we only go to KutyaOvi, but we will definitely try our exams here. The instructors are very nice, we learn a lot and, by the way, we have a great time, just like the dogs.

We just finished the basic course, we loved it😍 my one and a half year old dachshund loved it too, he has already gone home. We both learned a lot. I never thought I would ever reach the point where he would follow me at my feet, but I managed to do it here too🐶 We can't wait to start the intermediate course and then we'll go to the ÜgyesEB because I already miss all that learning, development, and the good team.❤️
We started with a dog daycare, followed by a wonderful basic course! With kind, knowledgeable instructors. We will definitely go again. The best place🥰🎉😘🐶 …
Great school, if you don't believe it, go to a FREE dog daycare session, afterwards you will have no doubt that you want to study here with your dog :)

We are currently attending a doggy daycare. We really enjoy the time we spend together, we get useful advice and I think we are in good hands, we are making progress in what we have to learn. 😀 Thank you! 🥰 …
I met an experienced, knowledgeable instructor in Peti! I recommend him to every owner!!

We just finished our basic course with them, and I highly recommend them to everyone. They are a very nice team who really know their stuff, and most importantly, my dog ​​loved being with them during the few weeks the course was taking place. We will definitely go and get them! 💗💫 …

My puppy, who was initially scared of his own shadow and terrified of all dogs, became a great dog friend after about two sessions thanks to the supervised socialization sessions at the dog daycare. It was very useful for us both to start enjoying walks and runs together, thank you very much :) The trainers we met were all kind, helpful, knowledgeable about dog behavior and handling. They also helped make the positive reinforcement-based development with my puppy easier and more enjoyable. We also learned new things, and they helped with useful advice in things that were challenging at home. I recommend them to everyone :)
They treat dogs with heart and soul and great expertise. Great dog school!

I recently became the lucky owner of a wonderful dog named Nimród, a little Golden Retriever. Dog owners in the 14th district recommended Dogitivity dog ​​walking, because I was sure that I wanted to develop the dog and build our relationship.
We started the daycare at 4 months old, and after the first session, they completely captivated me. During the daycare sessions, I was lucky to get to know several instructors. To meet them personally and experience their attitude, expertise, and love for animals, and of course, they always had kind words and praise for Nimród and other dogs.
This also confirmed that we are in the right place WITH THEM.
We continued our Dogitivity career with basic training and the Ramazuri classes. The puppy's development was maximal during these sessions, and I learned a lot from them, and since I started this journey with no experience, they were able to lend a helping hand and provide advice, which makes our everyday lives with Nimród and Goldi easier and more livable. :)

Overall, if I were to embark on this adventure again, I would definitely choose them again, because I can count on them, and this gives me security.
Thank you for everything so far, Nimród, and I'm glad you're here. :)

I recommend them to everyone. For now, we only go to the free kindergarten, but we will come here for future training. Family atmosphere, good-natured and prepared instructors, they love all dogs regardless of breed. They are ready to help, we can ask anything, anytime.

Update: we also completed the basic course, and we also take them to daycare when we can. They love our dog, the dog also runs to them, so everything is really fine/was. :)

I recommend Dogitivity and its trainers because they are selfless, enthusiastic and inspiring. They do not blame the owners, but rather give advice with sincere empathy and yet competently, helping them through the difficulties of dogs. We first met them at the free dog daycare, where we received useful, good advice from the first time and our dog Málna had a great time (and was tired too), and then we enrolled in the basic level.
If you do not want off-the-ground, elusive methods, but loving teaching and dog whispering, with an attitude in which the dog-owner relationship and practicality are the most important, go to them! :-)

We have already been to the free dog training center, where we decided that we will choose the Dogitivity team for the basic training as well. We just passed the exam today. I must say that we were very satisfied. Peti's expertise and Berni's enthusiasm captivate everyone and make them thirsty to work together with their dog. Thank you for all the encouragement and good advice and for your patience.

We have been to dog daycare here 3 times with Maxx.
Very good instructors teach classes.
We learn in a family atmosphere. We get a lot of help.
Great place. Thank you for being here! 😍 🐾🐾🐾 …

Very good dog school with excellent qualified instructors. We go to them for dog daycare and currently for a basic course. They always give good advice and make the class enjoyable for both the owner and the dog. :)

I highly recommend it to everyone. We completed a basic course with our dog, now we are continuing with the intermediate level.
7 of us started the basic group, and everyone received personalized advice and help for their dog, in addition, a Facebook group was opened, where we regularly uploaded the weekly tasks, and there everyone received detailed help with each post, and we could also talk at any time after the classes if we had any questions or requests.
Our difficulty was specifically the lack of food, when we arrived at the course the dog ran from one end of the leash to the other without any reason. A 10-month-old golden retriever weighing 30 kilos can be uncomfortable. Of course, he can still get a fever, but heaven and earth, and besides, the dog learned a lot of new smart things :)
As for me, the course classes were also such that I left home feeling discouraged several times due to the stress of everyday life, but the class regularly brought me back to life, they were always positive, cheerful, and energetic.
I also find the price of the course very fair.
So instead of 5 stars, I would give it 6.

With many years of experience with dogs, I can recommend this school. Great teaching staff: they really understand dogs and their training, they are supportive, encouraging personalities, and patient. The courses are well structured, useful, and progress is guaranteed. There are also great extracurricular programs.

We went to the Dogitivity dog ​​school for a basic course. Our trainer was very kind, attentive, and patient. He explained the mistakes, showed me everything I needed to do to become a smart dog owner. Of course, as it turned out, you don't just have to teach the dog, you have to teach the owner too. We had a great time. 🥰All 8 sessions were great. 🥰Thank you very much. ❤️
We'll continue because we want Füles to know the tricks too.
We can only recommend Dogitivity to everyone and we will continue to recommend it😍❤️
Patient, kind, helpful team, they love what they do. The course was a very good experience 😊🐾 …
